description: This file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) interface 'ConnectionDao' for managing 'ConnectionEntity' objects in a Room database. It provides methods for standard CRUD operations such as retrieving, inserting, updating, and deleting connection records, along with annotated queries for database interactions.

classes.name: ConnectionDao
classes.description: Interface annotated with @Dao, serving as a Data Access Object for performing database operations related to 'ConnectionEntity'. It includes methods for querying, inserting, updating, and deleting connection records in the database.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Returns a Flow that emits a list of all ConnectionEntity objects ordered by id in descending order.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Suspending function that fetches a ConnectionEntity by its primary key id.

methods.name: findByAlias
methods.description: Suspending function that finds a ConnectionEntity by its alias, returning the first match.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts or replaces a ConnectionEntity into the database, returning the row ID of the inserted record.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing ConnectionEntity in the database.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a specified ConnectionEntity from the database.

methods.name: deleteById
methods.description: Deletes a connection from the database using its primary key id.
